steps.error: The Zepp channel handshake failed. It will retry on the next connection.
steps.unsupported: This strap does not offer step data over Bluetooth.

tonight.payback: %1 earlier than usual to pay back sleep debt
tonight.free: Free morning: aim to be up by %1 to keep your rhythm
tonight.scheduleError: Wake-up time not understood for %1; using 07:00. Use a time like 07:00, or free.

settings.zoneInBar: Zone next to the heart rate
tooltip.moonLate: Past your bedtime. Stop now: %1 of sleep before %2
